say:2:1830198001:1.text: Senea sings well, but Adeline Ward of the Lightbearer Royal Opera House is miles ahead of her.
say:2:1830198001:1.source_cn: 塞涅唱得是不错，但比起我生前在耀光皇家歌剧院听过的那位...

say:3:1830198002:1.text: Her high notes could hit you right in the soul—spiritually, of course.
say:3:1830198002:1.source_cn: 那位的高音，才叫真正的穿透灵魂——当然，精神层面上的。

say:4:1830198003:1.text: There you go with Adeline again. She's been gone for centuries! It's hardly fair to compare Senea to her.
say:4:1830198003:1.source_cn: 你又拿艾德琳说事。她都是多少个世纪前的人物了，现在的孩...

say:5:1830198004:1.text: Hey, don't jump down my throat! I only said Senea didn't measure up to Adeline. That doesn't mean I think she's bad.
say:5:1830198004:1.source_cn: 所以我只是说“不如”，又没说她不好。

say:6:1830198005:1.text: Come on, drinks are on me. I owe you one for saving me a seat.
say:6:1830198005:1.source_cn: 走吧，请你喝酒，算是感谢你留的座。
